title: Tide breeding
combinationRule: 25 choose 2 = 300 unordered different-species pairs; no self-crosses

hybrids.name: Veilmaw Ursadrake
hybrids.descriptionSv: Björntunga tassar, drakhals och en svans av blå andeskalor.
hybrids.promptEn: One formidable bear-dragon hybrid: immense obsidian bear shoulders and four broad clawed bear paws, a curved elongated spectral dragon neck with one horned bear-dragon head and short bear ears, a long curling sapphire scaled tail. Black volcanic spine plates transition naturally into translucent blue scales. Strong planted silhouette; no wings.

hybrids.name: Bramble Coil
hybrids.descriptionSv: Kaninöron och kraftiga bakben på en slingrande liten drake.
hybrids.promptEn: A compact rabbit-wyrm hybrid with very long upright rabbit ears integrated beside silver dragon horns, a rounded rabbit muzzle with tiny dragon fangs, strong furry rabbit hind feet, short clawed forepaws, and a single long curled serpentine body-tail. Warm tawny fur transitions into translucent sapphire scales beneath a leafy bramble collar.

hybrids.name: Reefback Ursa
hybrids.descriptionSv: En bred björndrake med korallvingar och vulkaniska ryggplattor.
hybrids.promptEn: A hulking bear-drake with a broad bear muzzle, little round ears beside sea-green fin ears, four thick clawed bear paws and a thick curved dragon tail. Coral-red membranous wings emerge anatomically from powerful black-furred shoulders. Pink coral growths interlock with obsidian back armor. Compact powerful proportions, confident narrowed eyes.

hybrids.name: Thistleveil Gryphcat
hybrids.descriptionSv: Ett blått kattdjur med sparvens vingar, fjädertofs och klor.
hybrids.promptEn: An agile spectral panther-sparrow hybrid with a single catlike face ending in a short delicate beak, tufted thistle-purple feather crown, four feline legs with avian talons and folded sparrow wings attached to the shoulder blades. Long curling blue spectral cat tail ends in a russet feather fan. Feathered chest and translucent patterned blue flanks.

hybrids.name: Moonbrow Ursowl
hybrids.descriptionSv: Björnkropp med uggleansikte, stora fjädervingar och stentunga klor.
hybrids.promptEn: A stocky owl-bear with massive bear shoulders, four planted bear legs with hooked talons, a round moon-owl facial disk merged into one short bear muzzle and beak, and two large folded midnight-blue feather wings emerging from the back. Obsidian plates nest among shoulder feathers, silver crescent brow and stern golden eyes.

hybrids.name: Sunscarab
hybrids.descriptionSv: En flammande skalbaggsfågel med bärnstensskal och fjädervingar.
hybrids.promptEn: A phoenix-beetle hybrid with a single hooked amber beak-face, delicate beetle antennae below a flame-feather crown, a compact six-legged golden beetle body and two glowing amber wing cases opened above broad orange-red phoenix feather wings. Long layered phoenix tail feathers grow from the abdomen. Whole anatomy coherent and readable, no detached parts.

hybrids.name: Aurora Boghorn
hybrids.descriptionSv: En hornkrönt padda med pärlemorskalor, man och breda simhudsfötter.
hybrids.promptEn: A regal toad-kirin hybrid: low rounded toad torso on four muscular splayed webbed feet, one gentle elongated amphibian-kirin face, a spiraling opal forehead horn and long pointed kirin ears. Stony toad back nodules blend into iridescent overlapping kirin scales, and a flowing pastel aurora mane runs into a short tadpole-like curling tail.

hybrids.name: Glacier Reedrunner
hybrids.descriptionSv: Utterns långa kropp och simsvans med isbockens krökta horn.
hybrids.promptEn: A low streamlined otter-ibex with a whiskered otter face, paired backward-curving icy goat horns, small goat ears and a long furry aquatic torso. Four short powerful legs terminate in broad webbed cloven hoof-paws, a thick tapering otter tail stays fully visible. Cream and brown fur carries pale-blue crystalline shoulder tufts and a small reed ruff.

hybrids.name: Dusk Antlerwing
hybrids.descriptionSv: En hjort med nattfjärilsvingar, fjäderlika antenner och lysande horn.
hybrids.promptEn: An elegant chibi moth-stag quadruped with four slim hoofed deer legs, chestnut deer torso and one soft deer-moth face with feathery antennae. Branching antlers sweep around four velvety violet and dusky pink moth wings rooted naturally behind the shoulders. Mint luminous rune patterns repeat from deer flanks into the wing veins.

hybrids.name: Tempest Reefclaw
hybrids.descriptionSv: Ett lodjur med drakvingar, korallfjäll och blixtljusa morrhår.
hybrids.promptEn: A muscular lynx-drake crouched on four feline clawed paws: storm-gray lynx face, dark ear tufts joined to sea-green fin ears, cyan lightning whiskers and narrow alert eyes. Coral-pink scales grow over shoulders into two small membranous wings; a long curled dragon tail ends in a black lynx tuft. Fur and scale boundaries follow anatomy.

hybrids.name: Mossshell Vulpin
hybrids.descriptionSv: En räv med låg sköldpaddskropp, tydlig ryggsköld och buskig svans.
hybrids.promptEn: A fox-turtle hybrid with a sly russet fox muzzle, tall fox ears, a low compact fox torso covered by a real domed sea-glass turtle shell, and four sturdy clawed paws with pebbled reptile forearms. A full thick moss-tipped fox tail curves behind. Green moss grows in shell seams, preserving a fox's lively posture.

hybrids.name: Prismtusk
hybrids.descriptionSv: En vildsvinsödla med betar, kristallrygg och stora klättertår.
hybrids.promptEn: A squat boar-gecko with a broad boar snout, paired polished acorn tusks and clever gecko eyes, four powerful legs ending in wide lavender adhesive toe pads, and a long curled lizard tail. Brown bristly shoulders gradually become teal reptile scales; sharp turquoise crystal ridges rise along its muscular spine. One compact continuous body.

hybrids.name: Briarflare Cub
hybrids.descriptionSv: En lejonunge med grävlingens ansiktsränder och glödande taggman.
hybrids.promptEn: A sturdy lion-badger hybrid with broad digging forepaws, a low tough badger chest and powerful lion hindquarters. One young lion face bears bold cream-and-charcoal badger stripes and small fangs. Its compact mane is woven from natural green thorns with ember-orange tips; a full lion tail ends in a thorn-and-flame tuft.

hybrids.name: Crownfang
hybrids.descriptionSv: En långbent varglejon med gyllene man och glödande vargsvans.
hybrids.promptEn: A proud wolf-lion hybrid on four large clawed paws: lean wolf muzzle and upright wolf ears rise through a broad sun-gold lion mane streaked with ember-red tufts. Charcoal wolf shoulders merge into honey-gold lion flanks. Long bushy wolf tail has a flaming golden lion tuft; low focused brows and visible closed-mouth fangs.

hybrids.name: Astral Suncoil
hybrids.descriptionSv: En lång andedrake med fenixnäbb, eldvingar och böljande fjädersvans.
hybrids.promptEn: A spectacular phoenix-wyrm with one horned draconic bird head and hooked golden beak, an S-curved serpentine sapphire-scaled body, one pair of large layered orange-red phoenix wings and two small gold taloned legs. Its long coiled tail turns into flowing flame feathers. Translucent blue dragon belly contrasts with glowing dawn-feather back.

hybrids.name: Bramblewhisk
hybrids.descriptionSv: En rundörad skogshoppare med kaninbakben och lång mussvans med lövtofs.
hybrids.promptEn: Full-body fantasy chibi: A caramel woodland hopper combines mouse round ears stretched into broad rabbit ears, prominent whiskers and rabbit springing haunches. Four small pink paws, a long slender mouse tail ending in a bramble leaf tuft, cream belly and leafy cheek fur create an alert charming silhouette. Brown ink contours, painterly RPG finish; facing right.

hybrids.name: Pebblepocket
hybrids.descriptionSv: En stenknölig paddmus med runda öron, morrhår och breda simhudsfötter.
hybrids.promptEn: Full-body fantasy chibi: A squat amphibious mouse has rounded furry ears, whiskered pink muzzle and a toad's powerful folded hindquarters. Smooth cream belly meets slate pebble bumps growing naturally across tawny shoulders. Four webbed paws and a thin curled tadpole-like mouse tail balance the compact crouching body. Brown ink contours, painterly RPG finish; facing right.

hybrids.name: Seedwing
hybrids.descriptionSv: En liten musfågel med fjädervingar, fågelklor och mussvans med fjädervippa.
hybrids.promptEn: Full-body fantasy chibi: A small winged mouse has warm beige chest fur blending into russet sparrow flight feathers. Its short muzzle narrows into a delicate seed-cracking beak, broad round ears frame a purple thistle crest, two bird feet support its body, and a slender tail ends in a feather fan. Brown ink contours, painterly RPG finish; facing right.

hybrids.name: Sapscuttle
hybrids.descriptionSv: En sexbent bärnstensmus med skalrygg och runda känselöron.
hybrids.promptEn: Full-body fantasy chibi: A low six-legged creature combines a mouse's whiskered face, rounded pink ears and cream furry underside with curved amber beetle wing cases. Six jointed legs end in tiny pink grasping toes; a thin curled tail emerges naturally behind the shell and two short antennae rise between the ears. Brown ink contours, painterly RPG finish; facing right.

hybrids.name: Mossnibble
hybrids.descriptionSv: En mossrävsmus med runda öron, små gnagartassar och en tunn svans med mossig rot.
hybrids.promptEn: Combine one russet fox and field mouse into a compact chibi quadruped. Two oversized ROUND pink-lined mouse ears sit above a tapered fox muzzle ending in a tiny rodent nose and visible short incisors. Moss-green shoulder fur and a cream fox chest connect to rounded mouse hindquarters and delicate pink hindpaws. The tail starts with a short dense mossy fox brush, then extends into a much longer thin bare mouse curl. Keep a cunning fox gaze, complete feet and whole tail, facing right.

hybrids.name: Reedskipper
hybrids.descriptionSv: En långsmal utter-mus med runda öron, simhud och platt smalnande svans.
hybrids.promptEn: Full-body fantasy chibi: A sleek river mouse has an otter's elongated swimming torso, cream throat and four broad webbed paws. Oversized circular mouse ears and a tiny pink whiskered nose remain prominent. The thick otter tail narrows into a curling mouse tip, while reed-green dorsal fur forms a subtle comb. Brown ink contours, painterly RPG finish; facing right.

hybrids.name: Velvetwhisk
hybrids.descriptionSv: En lurvig musmal med rundade öron och fyra månmönstrade vingar.
hybrids.promptEn: Full-body fantasy chibi: A hovering mouse-moth has a plump beige furry abdomen, round pink mouse ears and long feathery antennae. Four violet wings grow from its shoulder segments, marked with pale crescents. Tiny mouse forepaws tuck near a whiskered muzzle; four delicate rear insect feet and a curling tail remain visible. Brown ink contours, painterly RPG finish; facing right.

hybrids.name: Burrowshell
hybrids.descriptionSv: En mus med naturligt välvt sköldpaddsskal och tassar som grävklor.
hybrids.promptEn: Full-body fantasy chibi: A sturdy turtle-mouse carries a naturally grown terracotta shell with golden spiral scutes over its round torso. Beige fur blends into jade scales at four broad digging paws. Round ears, a pink whiskered nose and a slender curled tail project clearly beyond the shell, giving a determined burrowing stance. Brown ink contours, painterly RPG finish; facing right.

hybrids.name: Acornsnout
hybrids.descriptionSv: En liten betförsedd vildsvinsmus med rundöron och randig borstpäls.
hybrids.promptEn: Full-body fantasy chibi: A barrel-bodied boar-mouse has round pink ears, a whiskered piglike snout and two tiny outward ivory tusks. Tawny piglet stripes cross its shaggy back; four short legs end in split clawed toes. A thin mouse tail curls behind an acorn-shaped bristly rump tuft, with a stubborn playful expression. Brown ink contours, painterly RPG finish; facing right.

hybrids.name: Cindercheek
hybrids.descriptionSv: En muslik eldkatt med stor mankrage, lejonframtassar och tunn glödsvans.
hybrids.promptEn: Full-body fantasy chibi: A compact mouse-lion has round oversized ears rising from a fiery cheek mane, a short whiskered muzzle and tiny visible incisors. Large lion forepaws support a beige furry torso above smaller mouse hindfeet. Its slender curled tail carries an ember tuft; orange chest fur glows only along the tips. Brown ink contours, painterly RPG finish; facing right.

hybrids.name: Moonmuzzle
hybrids.descriptionSv: En nattlig ugglemus med öronformad ansiktsskiva och mjuka silvervingar.
hybrids.promptEn: Full-body fantasy chibi: A round moon-owl mouse has a silver feather facial disk shaped around broad rounded mouse ears, a small pink beaked nose and prominent whiskers. Midnight-blue wings replace its forelimbs, two soft clawed feet support a cream furry belly, and a long mouse tail ends in a short silver feather tassel. Brown ink contours, painterly RPG finish; facing right.

hybrids.name: Prismwhisk
hybrids.descriptionSv: En fyrbent kristallmus med geckotår och lång kristalltaggig svans.
hybrids.promptEn: Full-body fantasy chibi: A lithe gecko-mouse has a whiskered cream muzzle and large round ears edged with translucent turquoise scales. Four lavender adhesive toes spread from each short limb; tawny belly fur merges into teal crystal back plates. Its long curling mouse tail thickens at the base into a gecko's faceted tail. Brown ink contours, painterly RPG finish; facing right.

hybrids.name: Staticnibbler
hybrids.descriptionSv: En kraftig lodjursmus med runda öron, svarta tofsar, rosa baktår och en lång bar svans.
hybrids.promptEn: Create one compact rodent-feline hybrid, with oversized CIRCULAR mouse ears carrying narrow black lynx tufts, not triangular cat ears. A broad lynx chest and snowshoe forepaws connect to visibly rounded mouse hindquarters and smaller pink hindtoes. Show a long thin bare pink mouse tail curling well outside the body, never a bobtail. Its short pointed mouse muzzle has two tiny incisors beneath feline cheek ruffs. Storm-grey fur and restrained cyan markings follow the powerful shoulders. Full connected chibi body, facing right.

hybrids.name: Briarburrow
hybrids.descriptionSv: En låg bred musgrävling med randigt ansikte och taggig skulderrygg.
hybrids.promptEn: Full-body fantasy chibi: A burrowing mouse-badger has a low broad torso, long shovel claws and rounded mouse ears protruding from thorny shoulder fur. Cream and charcoal facial stripes converge on its pink whiskered nose. Beige flanks soften the armored emerald ridge, while a long bare curled tail contrasts the powerful digging forequarters. Brown ink contours, painterly RPG finish; facing right.

hybrids.name: Ashwhisk
hybrids.descriptionSv: En vargmus med rundade musöron, gnagartår och en lång bar svans bakom glödmanen.
hybrids.promptEn: Design one sturdy wolf-mouse with enormous round pink-lined mouse ears, visible whiskers and a narrow rodent nose integrated into a moderately elongated canine jaw. Strong wolf forelegs and charcoal chest fur connect to round mouse haunches and small naked pink rear toes. The tail must be mostly thin, bare and curled, with only a short bushy base. A swept ember mane and fierce wolf brows contrast with two tiny mouse incisors. Complete chibi quadruped facing right, no separate creatures.

hybrids.name: Frostnibble
hybrids.descriptionSv: En hornprydd musbock med kluvna bakhovar och små framtassar.
hybrids.promptEn: Full-body fantasy chibi: A sure-footed ibex-mouse has short powerful haunches, four compact limbs and a cream furry barrel chest. Broad round mouse ears sit below two ridged backward-curving ice horns. Its forefeet retain grasping pink toes while hindfeet become tiny split hooves; a thin curled tail and long whiskers soften its stern face. Brown ink contours, painterly RPG finish; facing right.

hybrids.name: Sunwhisk Regent
hybrids.descriptionSv: En kunglig muslejonhybrid med rundöron, solman och kraftiga framtassar.
hybrids.promptEn: Full-body fantasy chibi: A proud mouse-lion has an oversized golden mane radiating around large round ears and a small whiskered muzzle with ivory incisors. Heavy lion forepaws and lighter mouse hindfeet support a compact honey-colored body. Its long fine tail ends in a sunburst tuft, creating a regal yet mischievous posture. Brown ink contours, painterly RPG finish; facing right.

hybrids.name: Runeburrow Hart
hybrids.descriptionSv: En liten mus-hjort med grenhorn, smala ben och lång mussvans.
hybrids.promptEn: Full-body fantasy chibi: A woodland mouse-stag has a compact cream-chested body lifted on slender short deer legs, tiny split hooves and wide rounded pink ears. Branching antlers grow behind its whiskered mouse face, with mint runes carved into their natural bark texture. A thin curled tail and beige shoulder fur preserve its mouse ancestry. Brown ink contours, painterly RPG finish; facing right.

hybrids.name: Reefwhisk Drakelet
hybrids.descriptionSv: En liten revdrake med musöron, morrhår och simhudsbeklädda klotassar.
hybrids.promptEn: Full-body fantasy chibi: A playful reef mouse-dragon has round fin-edged ears, a pink whiskered muzzle and a cream furry belly grading into coral scales. Four webbed clawed paws support the low body. Small red membrane wings join its shoulders, and its thin curled mouse tail broadens into a sea-green fin near the tip. Brown ink contours, painterly RPG finish; facing right.

hybrids.name: Dawnwhisk Flare
hybrids.descriptionSv: En musfågel med rundöron, flamfjädrar och lång solfjädersvans.
hybrids.promptEn: Full-body fantasy chibi: A radiant mouse-phoenix has a cream furry chest, round golden ears and a tiny beaked mouse muzzle with fine whiskers. Broad flame-shaped feather wings grow from its shoulders above two pink taloned feet. The long mouse tail unfurls into attached ember feathers, with amber light held tightly along its warm plumage. Brown ink contours, painterly RPG finish; facing right.

hybrids.name: Obsidian Squeakmaul
hybrids.descriptionSv: En bastant björnmus med rundöron, jättetassar och vulkaniska ryggplattor.
hybrids.promptEn: Full-body fantasy chibi: A stocky bear-mouse has immense rounded forepaws with digging claws, broad mouse ears and a compact whiskered muzzle bearing two small incisors. Charcoal fur and a cream belly meet glossy volcanic shoulder plates. A long thin mouse tail curls beside its heavy haunches, making the powerful squat silhouette unmistakably hybrid. Brown ink contours, painterly RPG finish; facing right.

hybrids.name: Aurora Whiskerhoof
hybrids.descriptionSv: En fjällig muskirin med pärlhorn, kluvna hovar och böljande aurorasvans.
hybrids.promptEn: Full-body fantasy chibi: A graceful mouse-kirin combines a tiny whiskered face and broad round ears with a compact deerlike body on four neat hooves. Lilac scales grow through cream fur; one pearly forehead horn and a flowing pastel mane frame its head. A slender mouse tail extends into attached mint and pink silky ribbons. Brown ink contours, painterly RPG finish; facing right.

hybrids.name: Veilwhisk Prowler
hybrids.descriptionSv: En blå genomskinlig muspanter med långa hörntänder, rundöron och smal svans.
hybrids.promptEn: Full-body fantasy chibi: A translucent sapphire panther-mouse crouches on broad feline paws beneath a compact sleek torso. Oversized round ears, a pink-blue whiskered nose and tiny incisors coexist with short icy saber fangs. Its long fine tail loops tightly left, while darker blue shoulder markings define real muscle beneath pale cyan edge light. Brown ink contours, painterly RPG finish; facing right.

hybrids.name: Astral Whiskercoil
hybrids.descriptionSv: En svävande musdrake med rundöron, morrhår och en lång fjällig spiralstjärt.
hybrids.promptEn: Full-body fantasy chibi: A floating serpentine mouse-dragon has a rounded whiskered dragon muzzle, oversized circular ears edged with silver fins and two tiny horns. Beige pearl chest fur blends into translucent sapphire scales along one continuous curled body. Tiny grasping forepaws and a long tapered mouse-like tail complete its compact S-shaped silhouette. Brown ink contours, painterly RPG finish; facing right.

hybrids.name: Bramblestone Hopper
hybrids.descriptionSv: En kompakt kaninpadda med långa mjuka öron och stenknöliga hoppben.
hybrids.promptEn: Full-body fantasy chibi: A rabbit-toad crouches on broad webbed hindfeet beneath oversized springing haunches. Long caramel ears frame amber protruding toad eyes and a cream rabbit muzzle. Sage leaf tufts blend into olive pebble-textured skin across the spine; short furry forepaws and a tiny rounded tail keep the charming silhouette balanced. Brown ink contours, painterly RPG finish; facing right.

hybrids.name: Thistletuft Jackwing
hybrids.descriptionSv: En kaninfågel med långa fjäderöron, fågelvingar och kraftiga hoppben.
hybrids.promptEn: Full-body fantasy chibi: A nimble rabbit-sparrow has long upright ears edged in russet feathers, a short beaked muzzle and cream cheek fur. Two compact feather wings fold against its caramel torso. Powerful rabbit hindlegs end in small bird talons, while a purple thistle crest and a rounded tail feather puff complete its springing silhouette. Brown ink contours, painterly RPG finish; facing right.

hybrids.name: Amberhop Carapace
hybrids.descriptionSv: En pansrad kanininsekt med känselöron, skalrygg och stora ledade bakben.
hybrids.promptEn: Full-body fantasy chibi: A rabbit-beetle stands on six short segmented limbs, the rear pair enlarged into rabbit jumping haunches with soft cream toes. Long velvety ears carry delicate antenna tips above a rabbit muzzle. Paired amber wing cases naturally enclose its caramel torso, with leafy ridges and a small white tail puff behind. Brown ink contours, painterly RPG finish; facing right.

hybrids.name: Bramblebrush Vulpin
hybrids.descriptionSv: En långörad rävkanin med kraftiga bakben och stor lövklädd rävsvans.
hybrids.promptEn: Full-body fantasy chibi: A long-eared rabbit-fox has a narrow fox muzzle, cream cheek ruff and oversized rabbit hindquarters. Four soft russet paws support a low agile body, while a lush moss-green fox tail sweeps behind. Sage leafy fur runs up the long ears and shoulder line, creating a clever alert woodland hunter. Brown ink contours, painterly RPG finish; facing right.

hybrids.name: Reedhop Paddler
hybrids.descriptionSv: En långsmal kaninutter med stora simhudsfötter och platt bred svans.
hybrids.promptEn: Full-body fantasy chibi: A river rabbit-otter combines a long sleek brown torso and broad flattened tail with tall caramel ears, a cream rabbit muzzle and powerful hopping haunches. Four webbed paws spread beneath it, rear feet noticeably longer. Reed-green cheek tufts and leafy ear edges create a natural aquatic bramble camouflage. Brown ink contours, painterly RPG finish; facing right.

hybrids.name: Duskear Flutterbun
hybrids.descriptionSv: En fluffig kaninmal med långa känselöron och fyra violetta vingar.
hybrids.promptEn: Full-body fantasy chibi: A soft rabbit-moth hovers with huge hindfeet tucked beneath its cream furry belly. Long rabbit ears feather into moth antennae above a caramel muzzle. Four violet crescent-patterned wings attach symmetrically to its shoulder and hip segments, while leafy cheek tufts and a small round tail blend into lilac body fur. Brown ink contours, painterly RPG finish; facing right.

hybrids.name: Brambleback Shelldancer
hybrids.descriptionSv: En kaninsköldpadda med stora hoppfötter, lövöron och välvt terrakottaskal.
hybrids.promptEn: Full-body fantasy chibi: A sturdy rabbit-turtle has a high rounded terracotta shell grown into its caramel back, bordered by sage leaf-shaped scutes. Long soft ears and a cream rabbit muzzle extend forward from a jade-scaled neck. Four visible feet include two powerful rabbit hindpaws; a small white tail protrudes behind the shell. Brown ink contours, painterly RPG finish; facing right.

hybrids.name: Tuskbriar Jackboar
hybrids.descriptionSv: En betförsedd kaningalt med långa öron och randig taggpäls.
hybrids.promptEn: Full-body fantasy chibi: A stocky rabbit-boar has long alert ears, a flattened whiskered snout and two small ivory tusks. Tan piglet stripes run over caramel fur into leafy bramble ridges. Its short muscular forelegs contrast powerful rabbit haunches and long split-toed hindfeet, while a bristly round tail and stubborn brow create a feisty stance. Brown ink contours, painterly RPG finish; facing right.

hybrids.name: Emberfoot Jacklion
hybrids.descriptionSv: En eldkanin med lejonman, stora framtassar och glödande hoppben.
hybrids.promptEn: Full-body fantasy chibi: A fiery rabbit-lion combines long caramel ears and springing rabbit haunches with oversized feline forepaws and a compact lion muzzle. Ember-red mane tufts grow through sage cheek leaves; orange fur ends in glowing tips along the shoulders. Its small rabbit tail becomes a round flame tuft above two long cream hindfeet. Brown ink contours, painterly RPG finish; facing right.

hybrids.name: Moonlop Sentinel
hybrids.descriptionSv: En långörad ugglekanin med silveransikte och midnattsblå vingar.
hybrids.promptEn: Full-body fantasy chibi: A watchful rabbit-owl has a silver facial disk around a short rabbit muzzle, long feather-edged ears and a crescent brow marking. Midnight-blue wings fold along its cream furry torso. Two powerful rabbit hindlegs end in taloned toes; leafy shoulder feathers and a soft round tail provide a compact grounded silhouette. Brown ink contours, painterly RPG finish; facing right.

hybrids.name: Crystalhop Skitter
hybrids.descriptionSv: En kristallkanin med geckotår, fjälliga öron och lång böjd svans.
hybrids.promptEn: Full-body fantasy chibi: A climbing rabbit-gecko crouches on strong rabbit haunches with four splayed lavender adhesive feet. Long ears carry translucent turquoise crystal ridges above a cream whiskered muzzle. Caramel belly fur blends into teal back scales, while a long tapered gecko tail curls around the small bramble-leaf rump tuft. Brown ink contours, painterly RPG finish; facing right.

hybrids.name: Thunderlop Pouncer
hybrids.descriptionSv: Ett kaninlodjur med långa tofsöron, stora hoppbakben och runda framtassar.
hybrids.promptEn: Create one athletic rabbit-lynx with exceptionally long upright rabbit ears, pink inner skin and black lynx tufts only at their tips. A small split rabbit lip sits inside broad feline cheek ruffs. Powerful folded bunny hindquarters rise above the lower shoulder line; two elongated rabbit hindfeet contrast with broad round lynx front paws. Show a round cream cotton tail, not a long cat tail. Storm-grey fur carries narrow cyan lightning marks through the shoulders and ears. Whole connected chibi animal facing right.

hybrids.name: Briarburrow Jackguard
hybrids.descriptionSv: En låg kaningrävling med långt randigt ansikte och taggiga öron.
hybrids.promptEn: Full-body fantasy chibi: A tough rabbit-badger has long ears edged with emerald thorns and a cream-charcoal striped face tapering to a rabbit nose. Broad digging forepaws balance strong rabbit haunches on a low grey torso. Dense bramble fur armor grows from its shoulders, with long cream hindfeet and a short white tail fully visible. hybrids.name: Cinderlop Fangrunner
hybrids.descriptionSv: En kaninvarg med långa öron, vargmule och flammande ryggkam.
hybrids.promptEn: Full-body fantasy chibi: A lean rabbit-wolf has a narrow canine muzzle with small closed-mouth fangs beneath tall rabbit ears. Charcoal forequarters and strong wolf paws merge with massive rust-colored rabbit hindlegs. Ember mane tufts thread through sage cheek leaves; a short bushy tail and elongated rear feet create an aggressive bounding silhouette. Brown ink contours, painterly RPG finish; facing right.

hybrids.name: Frostlop Craghare
hybrids.descriptionSv: En kaninbergget med långa öron, stora hoppbakben, ishorn och klövade fötter.
hybrids.promptEn: Create one mountain rabbit-ibex whose two extremely long rabbit ears rise clearly beside, not behind, two backward-curving ice horns. Keep a small rabbit nose, obvious split upper lip and round cotton tail. Its silhouette has huge folded rabbit hindquarters, low shoulders and elongated rear feet ending in split hoof tips; smaller front hooves brace the chest. White goat wool and a short beard frame the throat, while pale blue frost ridges follow the back. Whole connected chibi animal facing right.

hybrids.name: Sunlop Pridebound
hybrids.descriptionSv: En solgul kaninlejonhybrid med mäktig man och stora hoppben.
hybrids.promptEn: Full-body fantasy chibi: A regal rabbit-lion has a broad golden mane framing long upright caramel ears and a cream rabbit muzzle with small feline fangs. Muscular lion forepaws contrast long powerful rabbit hindfeet. Honey fur carries leaf-shaped mane layers, and a round glowing tail tuft balances its proud compact stance. Brown ink contours, painterly RPG finish; facing right.

hybrids.descriptionSv: En liten ugglefjäril med ansiktskrans, klor och fyra fjärilsvingar kantade av fjädrar.
hybrids.promptEn: Fuse a compact owl chest and silver facial disk with feathery moth antennae and four rounded violet membrane wings. Midnight feathers grow along each wing margin, silver crescents sit within the membranes, and two sturdy owl talons support a soft segmented abdomen.

hybrids.name: Prismwing Skitter
hybrids.descriptionSv: En kristallgecko med stora tådynor, böjd svans och fyra mjuka nattfjärilsvingar.
hybrids.promptEn: Create a low turquoise gecko with splayed lavender adhesive toes and a curled crystalline tail. Four dusk-violet moth wings grow from a soft furry shoulder thorax, their membranes interrupted by tiny crystal veins. Feathery antennae frame an angular lizard brow above focused eyes.

hybrids.name: Tempest Silkmane
hybrids.descriptionSv: En kraftig lodjursfjäril med tofsöron, antenner och fyra blixtådrade vingar.
hybrids.promptEn: Combine powerful lynx haunches, oversized feline forepaws and black ear tufts with a plush moth thorax ruff. Four angular violet membrane wings emerge behind the shoulders, crossed by pale cyan branching veins. Long whiskers curve upward into paired feathery antennae; the tail stays short and feline.

hybrids.name: Briar Velvetmaw
hybrids.descriptionSv: En grävling med randigt ansikte, taggig rygg och veckade nattfjärilsvingar.
hybrids.promptEn: Build a squat digging beast with a badger striped muzzle and broad shovel claws. Four thick moth wings fold like serrated leaves along its back, anchored between emerald thorn ridges. Lavender thorax fur blends into charcoal badger flanks, while brushlike antennae sweep back from small rounded ears.

hybrids.name: Ashsilk Nightfang
hybrids.descriptionSv: En varglik nattfjäril med glödande nackpäls och långa sotfärgade vingar.
hybrids.promptEn: Make a lean wolf with a long fanged muzzle, springy canine legs and a full brush tail. Its red ember neck mane becomes moth thorax fluff, supporting four narrow smoke-violet wings with copper veins. Feathered antennae rise beside pointed ears, and wing tips curl like singed velvet.

hybrids.name: Rimewing Clamber
hybrids.descriptionSv: En bergsget med ishorn och frostiga fjärilsvingar som växer ur ullen.
hybrids.promptEn: Combine an ibex barrel chest, cloven hooves and two sweeping ice horns with a moth abdomen tapering into a short fuzzy tail. Four broad violet wings emerge through white shoulder wool, crystal frost tracing their scalloped edges. Fine antennae curve between the horns above a determined goat face.

hybrids.name: Gilded Nightpride
hybrids.descriptionSv: Ett lejon med fjärilsmjuk man, antenner och fyra solkantade nattvingar.
hybrids.promptEn: Create a muscular lion whose circular mane is layered moth fluff and golden fur. Four broad violet membrane wings emerge from the shoulder girdle, their margins fringed with sun-gold hairs. Keep a feline muzzle, broad paws, tufted lion tail and paired plume antennae rising through the mane.

hybrids.name: Reefsilk Wyrmling
hybrids.descriptionSv: En koralldrake med antenner och fyra fjärilsvingar mellan koralltaggarna.
hybrids.promptEn: Merge a coral drake snout, four clawed legs and curled scaled tail with a soft moth thorax. Replace dragon wing membranes with four scalloped violet moth wings supported by coral finger bones. Sea-green fin ears frame feathery antennae; coral spines continue along the upper back.

hybrids.name: Daybreak Moonflutter
hybrids.descriptionSv: En fågelfjäril med rovfågelsnäbb, klor och fyra fjäderkantade vingar.
hybrids.promptEn: Design a regal bird-moth with a phoenix hooked beak and two strong avian feet below a fluffy lilac thorax. Four expansive moth wings have golden feathered leading edges and violet crescent membranes. A short segmented abdomen extends into layered sunrise tail plumes, with two delicate antennae above the crest.

hybrids.name: Blackglass Silkback
hybrids.descriptionSv: En tung björn med stenspalter över ryggen och fyra sotlila fjärilsvingar.
hybrids.promptEn: Create a massive bear with heavy shoulders, round ears and planted clawed paws. Four thick moth wings rise from gaps between natural obsidian shoulder plates; violet velvet membranes carry silver crescents. Soft thorax fur forms its chest, and broad feathery antennae emerge above a stern bear brow.

hybrids.name: Aurorasilk Courser
hybrids.descriptionSv: En kirin med klövar, pärlhorn och skimrande fjärilsvingar som möter manen.
hybrids.promptEn: Fuse a cream kirin body, neat cloven hooves and pearly forehead horn with four rounded moth wings. Their lilac membranes grow from scaled shoulders and flow into mint-pink mane filaments. Feathery antennae sweep back beside deer ears, while a furry segmented tail finishes in silky aurora strands.

hybrids.name: Veilwing Prowler
hybrids.descriptionSv: En smygande blå panter med genomskinliga nattvingar och antenner kring öronen.
hybrids.promptEn: Make a sleek sapphire panther crouching on four broad feline paws, with a long curved tail. Four translucent moth wings grow directly from its shoulder muscles, edged in fuzzy midnight hairs with silver crescents. Paired feather antennae arc behind cat ears; pale cyan currents follow wing veins into the flanks.

hybrids.name: Moonveil Silkserpent
hybrids.descriptionSv: En svävande andedrake med böjd kropp, pälsig bröstkrans och fyra nattfjärilsvingar.
hybrids.promptEn: Build a compact floating S-shaped serpent with a horned dragon head and complete tapered tail. A moth thorax ruff surrounds its upper neck, supporting four large violet membrane wings. Feathered antennae extend beside silver horns, while sapphire belly scales gradually become soft lilac segments toward the wing roots.

hybrids.name: Acorn Bastionhog
hybrids.descriptionSv: En låg vildsvinspadda med betar, klövar och en välvd sköldpaddssköld.
hybrids.promptEn: Combine a round terrapin shell and heavy low turtle shoulders with a boar snout, short ivory tusks and four stout cloven feet. Brown striped bristles grow between warm terracotta shell panels, while jade scaled cheeks meet a blunt pig muzzle. A short curled tail emerges below the shell rim.

hybrids.name: Cinder Shellpride
hybrids.descriptionSv: Ett lejon med glödande man kring halsen och en sköld som växer ur ryggen.
hybrids.promptEn: Create a compact lion with broad padded paws and a rounded terrapin shell integrated into its back. Ember mane tufts frame the shell opening around the neck, exposing jade scales beneath orange cheek fur. The tail is thick at its turtle base and ends in a fiery lion tuft.

hybrids.name: Mooncarapace Watcher
hybrids.descriptionSv: En uggla med rund ryggsköld, fjälliga klor och silverfjädrar längs skalet.
hybrids.promptEn: Make a stout upright owl with a silver facial disk, hooked beak and two strong scaled talons. A terracotta turtle shell forms the rounded back, with folded midnight wings emerging from its side openings. Jade scales cover the lower neck; small feathers trace the shell seams and crescent-shaped rim.

hybrids.name: Prismplate Snapper
hybrids.descriptionSv: En sköldpaddsgecko med klättertår, lång svans och kristalliserade skalplattor.
hybrids.promptEn: Fuse a low turtle shell and broad reptile head with a gecko flexible spine, splayed adhesive toes and long curled tail. Terracotta scutes become raised turquoise crystal facets toward the spine, leaving the protective rim clearly visible. Lavender toe pads and narrow focused eyes emphasize the agile gecko anatomy.

hybrids.name: Thunderplate Stalker
hybrids.descriptionSv: Ett lodjur med skyddande ryggsköld, stora tassar och blixtar längs skalets fogar.
hybrids.promptEn: Design a crouched lynx with tall tufted ears, broad cat paws and compact hindquarters. A high terrapin shell grows over its back, split into warm ochre plates by cyan lightning seams. Jade scales armor the ankles beneath grey fur, and a short bobtail protrudes through the rear shell opening.

hybrids.name: Briarback Rampart
hybrids.descriptionSv: En grävling med grävklor, randigt ansikte och en taggig sköldpaddsrygg.
hybrids.promptEn: Give a low badger body a broad domed turtle shell edged with emerald thorn growths. Its cream-and-charcoal striped muzzle extends from a jade scaled neck, and heavy digging foreclaws support the shell. Rough grey fur emerges between the shell rim and muscular hind legs; a short badger tail remains visible.

hybrids.name: Furnace Shellfang
hybrids.descriptionSv: En varg med sotig päls, tänder och en tung glödande ryggsköld.
hybrids.promptEn: Combine a wolf long muzzle, pointed ears and powerful canine legs with a terrapin carapace fitted to its hunched back. Orange mane fur spills around the shell front; ochre plates bear thin ember seams. Jade ankle scales transition to charcoal paws, and a full wolf brush tail exits the shell.

hybrids.name: Glacier Carapace
hybrids.descriptionSv: En bergsget med ishorn och en sköld vars kant liknar packis.
hybrids.promptEn: Create a sturdy ibex with swept ice horns, a short beard and four cloven hooves. Its barrel torso is enclosed in a turtle shell, terracotta panels frosted into blue facets along the rim. White wool protrudes naturally from neck and leg openings, with jade scales on its lower muzzle.

hybrids.name: Solstice Shieldlion
hybrids.descriptionSv: Ett tungt lejon med solman, breda tassar och en hög ryggsköld.
hybrids.promptEn: Fuse a large golden lion chest and round mane with a terrapin domed back and plated underbelly. The mane frames the shell neck opening in short thick rays. Broad clawed paws have jade scaled wrists; ochre shell scutes echo the mane layering, and a full tufted tail curls around the rear.

hybrids.name: Runebark Shellhart
hybrids.descriptionSv: En hornprydd hjort med klövar och ett skal som möter barkliknande ryggplattor.
hybrids.promptEn: Give a stag branching antlers, fine cloven legs and a cream throat beneath a turtle shell. The high carapace is warm brown with mint rune grooves, merging into barklike scutes around the shoulders. Jade scales appear on the long deer muzzle and knees, while the short deer tail emerges below the rim.

hybrids.name: Coral Citadelle
hybrids.descriptionSv: En fyrbent revdrake med sköld, korallvingar och kraftig böjd svans.
hybrids.promptEn: Make a squat reef dragon with coral horns, sea-green cheek fins and four powerful clawed legs. A terrapin shell replaces the upper back, with coral branches growing from its scute seams. Small membranous dragon wings attach beside the shell rim, and the long scaled tail curls outside the protective silhouette.

hybrids.name: Sunvault Firecrest
hybrids.descriptionSv: En fågel med sköldpaddsrygg, gyllene vingar och två kraftiga klor.
hybrids.promptEn: Build an upright phoenix with hooked golden beak, avian talons and broad sunrise wings. A rounded turtle carapace covers its back, with feathers growing from the side openings and warm shell seams. Jade scales form the lower throat and feet; layered flame-tail plumes extend completely beyond the shell rim.

hybrids.name: Blackvault Ursadon
hybrids.descriptionSv: En massiv björn med bred sköldpaddsrygg och stenhårda skulderplattor.
hybrids.promptEn: Combine a bear enormous forequarters, broad muzzle and four planted clawed paws with a high terrapin shell. Obsidian armor plates replace the upper scutes, transitioning to warm ochre panels at the rim. Jade scales cover the neck below dense charcoal fur; retain small round bear ears and a short heavy tail.

hybrids.name: Pearlshell Kirin
hybrids.descriptionSv: En lätt kirin med pärlhorn, klövar och skimrande fjäll kring ryggskölden.
hybrids.promptEn: Create a compact kirin with a pearly forehead horn, flowing pastel mane and four delicate hooves. Its back carries a naturally grown turtle carapace, with terracotta panels merging into lilac scales around the neck. The mane threads between shell ridges, while its long silky tail extends freely from the rear opening.

hybrids.name: Veilvault Prowler
hybrids.descriptionSv: En blå panter med sköldpaddsrygg och ljus som löper genom skalets fogar.
hybrids.promptEn: Make a low stalking panther with narrow feline face, large paws and a curved muscular tail. A terrapin shell arches over its back, its strong rounded scutes translucent sapphire at the edges. Jade scales blend into spectral blue fur along the wrists; cyan currents follow the shell seams into the legs.

hybrids.name: Astral Coilback
hybrids.descriptionSv: En slingrande draksköldpadda med kraftigt skal, böjd hals och lång andesvans.
hybrids.promptEn: Fuse a broad terrapin shell and four sturdy turtle feet with an elongated horned dragon neck and serpentine tail. Sapphire scales flow out of the warm plated carapace, curling into a compact S silhouette behind it. Silver horns, cyan throat fins and a pale segmented belly reveal the spectral wyrm inheritance.

hybrids.name: Cinder Tuskcub
hybrids.descriptionSv: Ett knubbigt lejonvildsvin med betar, glödman och kraftiga framtassar.
hybrids.promptEn: Create a stocky lion cub with a blunt boar snout, ivory side tusks and powerful front paws. Short cloven rear feet brace beneath striped brown haunches. Its ember mane grows from a boar bristle ridge, and a curled pig tail ends in a warm red lion tuft.

hybrids.name: Moonroot Tuskowl
hybrids.descriptionSv: En kompakt ugglesvinhybrid med betar, fjädrar och starka grävklor.
hybrids.promptEn: Merge a round boar barrel body with a broad owl chest and folded midnight feather wings. A silver facial disk frames a short piglike muzzle carrying a small hooked upper beak and ivory tusks. Two heavy front digging talons and stout rear cloven feet support striped bristled flanks.

hybrids.name: Thunderroot Razorback
hybrids.descriptionSv: Ett kraftigt lodjurssvin med rosa tryne, tydliga betar, örontofsar och klövade bakfötter.
hybrids.promptEn: Create one muscular boar-lynx with a prominent flat upturned PINK PIG SNOUT and two large ivory tusks curving upward beside a single closed feline jaw. Tall black lynx ear tufts and wide cheek ruffs frame this unmistakably piglike face. Its barrel boar hindbody has striped bristles and two sturdy cloven rear hooves, while powerful feline forelegs end in broad padded paws. A hard raised razorback bristle ridge carries narrow cyan lightning veins through storm-grey fur. Show a short curled pig tail. Full-body chibi, facing right.

hybrids.name: Briartusk Burrower
hybrids.descriptionSv: Ett grävlingsvildsvin med uppvänt rosa tryne, stora betar, grävklor och taggig borstkam.
hybrids.promptEn: Make one low heavy badger-boar whose cream-and-charcoal BADGER FACE STRIPES lead into a broad upturned pink pig snout, with two conspicuous ivory tusks rising beside the closed mouth. Huge badger digging forearms end in broad shovel claws; round boar hindquarters stand on clearly split rear hooves. Hard brown dorsal bristles interlock with emerald thorn ridges, leaving both textures recognizable. Small rounded ears and a short curled pig tail complete the compact silhouette. Keep the rooting muzzle dominant rather than a pointed badger nose. Full-body chibi.

hybrids.name: Embertusk Ravager
hybrids.descriptionSv: En vargsvinshybrid med lång käke, utstående betar och glödande borstman.
hybrids.promptEn: Create a forward-leaning predator with a long wolf jaw widened into a boar rooting nose and two upward ivory tusks. Powerful canine forepaws contrast with stocky boar hindquarters and cloven rear feet. Charcoal fur carries a raised red bristle mane, while the full brush tail curls slightly at its tip.

hybrids.name: Rimehorn Tuskram
hybrids.descriptionSv: Ett vildsvin med ishorn, betar och tät vit bergsgetsull.
hybrids.promptEn: Combine a broad boar snout and ivory tusks with a compact ibex chest, split hooves and two long swept ice horns. Dense white goat wool grows around dark striped piglet flanks; icy bristles continue down the back. A small beard under the tusked jaw balances a short curled tail.

hybrids.name: Goldtusk Pridebreaker
hybrids.descriptionSv: Ett tungt lejon med vildsvinsnos, betar och en man av gyllene borst.
hybrids.promptEn: Build a muscular golden lion with a broad boar nose and ivory tusks growing beside its feline fangs. Its circular mane becomes layered golden bristles, continuing into a raised razorback ridge. Large front paws and stout cloven rear feet carry a barrel torso, ending in a curled tufted tail.

hybrids.name: Runetusk Wildhart
hybrids.descriptionSv: En hjortsvinshybrid med greniga horn, betar och runor mellan borststråna.
hybrids.promptEn: Give a sturdy boar chest four longer stag legs and dark cloven hooves. A deer brow with branching wooden antlers slopes into a short tusked rooting muzzle. Chestnut bristles carry mint rune channels, and a cream deer throat tuft joins the bristled chest; keep a short curled boar tail.

hybrids.name: Reeftusk Broodling
hybrids.descriptionSv: En koralldrake med betar, vildsvinsnos och korta kraftiga ben.
hybrids.promptEn: Make a stocky coral drake with a flattened boar snout, broad ivory tusks and a bristled cheek ruff. Four short clawed legs support its barrel torso; coral wings and sea-green fins grow from the shoulders. A long curled scaled tail retains a tiny bristle tuft, with piglet stripes visible between coral plates.

hybrids.name: Sunbristle Firehog
hybrids.descriptionSv: Ett vildsvin med gyllene fjädervingar, betar och en flammande stjärtplym.
hybrids.promptEn: Fuse a boar sturdy barrel chest and tusked rooting muzzle with a phoenix sharp hooked upper beak and broad golden wings. Brown bristles transition into orange feather quills along its spine. Four stout legs end in hooked hooflike claws, and a compact fan of flame feathers replaces the curled tail.

hybrids.name: Blacktusk Mauler
hybrids.descriptionSv: En enorm björnsvinshybrid med betar, framtassar och sprucken vulkanrygg.
hybrids.promptEn: Create a heavy bear with towering shoulders and enormous clawed forepaws, a boar barrel belly and stout cloven hind feet. Its broad muzzle ends in a rooting nose flanked by ivory tusks. Charcoal fur and brown bristles grow between natural obsidian back plates, with a short curled bristle tail.

hybrids.name: Opaltusk Courser
hybrids.descriptionSv: En kirin med pärlhorn, vildsvinsbetar och skimrande borst längs ryggen.
hybrids.promptEn: Combine a kirin arched neck, pearly horn and four graceful cloven hooves with a compact boar torso and blunt tusked muzzle. Lilac scales emerge through brown striped bristles, while a pastel flowing mane follows the spine. A short curled boar tail extends into mint-pink silky strands.

hybrids.name: Veiltusk Pouncer
hybrids.descriptionSv: En blå panter med vildsvinets breda nos, betar och kraftiga bakkropp.
hybrids.promptEn: Design a crouched spectral panther with wide feline paws and a long curved tail, but a boar powerful barrel hindbody and flattened tusked muzzle. Sapphire bristles form a raised shoulder ridge, pale cyan stripes crossing its translucent flanks. Rounded pig ears blend into pointed feline rims above fierce narrow eyes.

hybrids.name: Astral Tuskcoil
hybrids.descriptionSv: En betförsedd andedrake med vildsvinsbogar och lång slingrande svans.
hybrids.promptEn: Fuse a heavy boar shoulder barrel and four short split-hoof feet with an elongated serpentine dragon neck and full curling tail. The horned head has a broad rooting nose and ivory side tusks. Brown bristles along the shoulder spine transition smoothly into translucent sapphire scales and pale cyan fins.

hybrids.name: Crescent Cindergriff
hybrids.descriptionSv: En lejonunge med ugglevingar, ansiktskrans och glödande fjäderman.
hybrids.promptEn: Fuse a lion cub torso and padded hind paws with feathered owl forelimbs ending in curved talons. A silver owl facial disk surrounds a short feline muzzle and hooked beak tip. Midnight wings emerge behind an ember feather mane, while a tufted lion tail stays fully visible.

hybrids.name: Cinderprism Cub
hybrids.descriptionSv: En kristallfjällig lejonunge med klättertår och en lång glödspetsad svans.
hybrids.promptEn: Give a fiery lion cub a longer gecko torso and curled scaled tail, keeping its rounded feline cheeks and small ember mane. Four broad feet separate into lavender adhesive toes beneath furry ankles. Turquoise crystal spines grow through orange shoulder fur and continue into the tail flame tuft.

hybrids.name: Sparkmane Lynxcub
hybrids.descriptionSv: Ett smidigt lodjurslejon med tofsöron, stor man och kraftiga baktassar.
hybrids.promptEn: Combine a young lion broad chest and small red mane with a lynx long springing hindlegs, large snowshoe paws and tall black ear tufts. A short bobtail sprouts a compact ember plume. Grey flank fur carries fine cyan streaks that branch into the warm mane roots.

hybrids.name: Coalheart Fangcub
hybrids.descriptionSv: En bredaxlad lejonvarg med spetsöron och en dubbel glödman.
hybrids.promptEn: Merge a lion cub round chest, padded forepaws and cheek mane with a wolf long fanged muzzle, tall pointed ears and springy hindlegs. Two distinct mane layers form a compact circular lion ruff and a swept canine dorsal crest. The long brush tail ends in a dense ember tuft.

hybrids.name: Rimecinder Horncub
hybrids.descriptionSv: En lejonunge med ishorn, klövade bakfötter och frost i glödmanen.
hybrids.promptEn: Build a sturdy young lion with two swept crystalline ibex horns growing above rounded feline ears. Padded front paws and cloven back hooves support a compact goatlike barrel. White wool forms the lower beard, while orange ember mane strands curve around icy horn bases; a small tufted tail remains clear.

hybrids.name: Twincrest Solarpride
hybrids.descriptionSv: Ett kraftigt lejon med en inre glödman och en yttre solfjäderformad man.
hybrids.promptEn: Create a compact powerful lion with oversized cub paws, short sturdy limbs and mature Sunmane jaw muscles. Its mane has two anatomically distinct layers: a tight inner ember ruff and broad outer golden cheek fins sweeping backward like rays. The lion tail has a forked double tuft echoing both mane layers.

hybrids.name: Cinderbranch Hartcub
hybrids.descriptionSv: En lejonunge med hjorthorn, klövade bakben och runor under glödmanen.
hybrids.promptEn: Combine a lion cub chest, small ember mane and rounded feline muzzle with a stag branching antlers and long cloven hindlegs. Broad padded forepaws remain lionlike. Mint rune channels trace the chestnut flanks between short orange fur, while the elongated neck and cream throat transition naturally into the mane.

hybrids.name: Cinderreef Whelp
hybrids.descriptionSv: En lejonunge med korallvingar, fjällsvans och små horn genom manen.
hybrids.promptEn: Make a compact feline dragon with broad lion cub paws, an orange ember mane and a short fanged muzzle. Coral horns grow through the mane and small teal membrane wings attach at the shoulders. Coral scales blend into furry hips, continuing along a fully curled dragon tail tipped with ember fur.

hybrids.name: Dawncrest Liongriff
hybrids.descriptionSv: En lejonfågel med flammande vingar, klor och en fjäderman kring ansiktet.
hybrids.promptEn: Fuse a lion cub broad torso and feline hindpaws with a phoenix feathered forechest, hooked front talons and two golden wings. Its short cat muzzle has a small beaked upper tip, framed by a compact ember feather mane. The lion tail opens into a curved three-plume sunrise fan.

hybrids.name: Emberstone Bruiser
hybrids.descriptionSv: En björnlik lejonunge med stora tassar och svarta stenplattor runt glödmanen.
hybrids.promptEn: Give a stout lion cub enormous bear shoulders, round bear ears and heavy planted forepaws. Its small orange mane emerges between obsidian plates around the neck and upper back. A shortened broad bear muzzle retains feline cheek pads, while the stocky rear body carries a thick ember-tipped lion tail.

hybrids.name: Opalflare Fawncub
hybrids.descriptionSv: En hornprydd lejonunge med kirinens hals, klövar och pastellfärgad man.
hybrids.promptEn: Combine a lion cub padded forepaws and compact ember cheek ruff with an arched kirin neck, pearly forehead horn and cloven rear hooves. Lilac scales run through orange shoulder fur. Flowing mint-pink mane strands braid visually with fiery red tufts, and a long silky tail retains a small lion tuft.

hybrids.name: Veilcinder Stalker
hybrids.descriptionSv: En blå panter med lejonungens kraftiga tassar och en låg glödande man.
hybrids.promptEn: Create a low feline hunter with Spectral Panther long spine, curved tail and narrow eyes, enlarged by lion cub forepaws and a compact circular mane. The mane grows into a raised ember dorsal fin of fur. Orange chest hairs transition into translucent sapphire flanks, preserving a single strong muscular silhouette.

hybrids.name: Astral Manecoil
hybrids.descriptionSv: En andedrake med lejonungens bogar, framtassar och liten eldig man.
hybrids.promptEn: Fuse a lion cub stout chest and four padded paws with a long spectral dragon neck and curling scaled tail. The horned dragon face retains broad feline cheek pads, surrounded by an ember mane. Orange fur transitions into sapphire scales along the neck, with pale cyan fins emerging between mane tufts.

hybrids.name: Prismmoon Climber
hybrids.descriptionSv: En ugglegecko med ansiktskrans, fjädervingar och stora lila klättertår.
hybrids.promptEn: Create a low gecko with a curved crystal tail, silver owl facial disk and small hooked beak. Folded midnight feather wings grow from its shoulders above four splayed adhesive feet. Turquoise scales alternate with soft chest feathers, and crescent crystal plates rise along its back beneath focused golden eyes.

hybrids.name: Thunderdisc Prowler
hybrids.descriptionSv: Ett lodjur med ugglans ansiktskrans, vingar och fjäderklädda framtassar.
hybrids.promptEn: Combine a lynx muscular quadruped body, broad hindpaws and short bobtail with an owl silver facial disk and hooked beak tip. Midnight wings attach behind tufted shoulders, while front paws grow curved avian claws. Tall black ear tufts merge with feather crests, crossed by fine cyan lightning veins.

hybrids.name: Briarmoon Digger
hybrids.descriptionSv: En grävling med ugglekrans, klor och fjädervingar under ryggtaggarna.
hybrids.promptEn: Make a squat badger with a long striped muzzle framed by an owl circular silver face ruff. Folded feather wings sit beneath emerald thorn shoulder ridges. Heavy forefeet combine badger digging claws and owl talons, while charcoal hindquarters and a short tail support a dense midnight feathered chest.

hybrids.name: Ashmoon Howler
hybrids.descriptionSv: En varg med ugglevingars fjädrar, silverkrans och en flammande nackkam.
hybrids.promptEn: Fuse a wolf long muzzle, canine legs and full brush tail with an owl broad facial disk and strong feathered wings. Silver face feathers wrap the muzzle without replacing its fangs. Midnight flight feathers grow through ember shoulder fur, and black ear points curve into an alert owl crest.

hybrids.name: Frostmoon Hornwing
hybrids.descriptionSv: En bergsget med ugglevingar, ansiktskrans och två stora ishorn.
hybrids.promptEn: Create an ibex with four cloven hooves and tall swept ice horns above a silver owl facial disk. A short hooked beak tip joins its goat muzzle and beard. Midnight wings grow from its woolly shoulders, with white feather down blending into blue-frosted flank wool and a compact fanned tail.

hybrids.name: Mooncrown Gryphlion
hybrids.descriptionSv: Ett lejon med bred ugglekrans, gyllene fjäderman och stora nattvingar.
hybrids.promptEn: Build a proud lion with broad padded hindpaws and taloned feathered forefeet. A silver owl facial disk sits within a full golden lion mane, surrounding one short feline-beaked muzzle. Large midnight wings rise behind the mane; the tufted lion tail fans into silver-tipped feathers at its end.

hybrids.name: Runemoon Antlerwing
hybrids.descriptionSv: En hjort med ugglevingars silhuett, ansiktskrans och greniga horn.
